Its product tree is `origin/main` `022c6e799`; the branch adds `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` only. Built with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (75/75 tasks green).
- `.objectui-sha`: `daeb77fc84dd824e74c95b87cdede85afdb248e7` (no console in this item).
- command: `node packages/cli/bin/run.js migrate meta …` with stdin from `/dev/null`, run inside scratch copies of `examples/app-showcase` (`node_modules` symlinked). The checked-out app was never the subject of a run.
- trees: `app0` stock; `app1` planted (the runs without --write); `app2` planted (WRITE MODE) with a byte copy `app2.orig`; `app3` planted (`--write --json`). The plants are four retired spellings: `striped: true` on the `All Projects` list view (`17.ui__ListView__striped`), `currencyConfig.precision: 2` on a plain-literal currency field `fee` (`18.data__CurrencyConfig__precision`), `errorHandling.retryDelayMs` on a flow, and `defaultValue: '10:00Z'` on a time field.
- timestamps: 2026-10-16, 16:28Z to 16:34Z.

## Scope

Selector `cli.migrate-meta-codemod` resolves to 1 runnable item: `cli.migrate-meta-codemod` at revision 5, P1, surface cli. The item text was read at branch head `c4bf2ba4e`. After the run, step 8's parenthetical about the runtime's protocol major was corrected to 18, which the `Chain:` line below measures. No pin is declared (`automated` unset). The supporting suite `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/migrate-meta-write.test.ts` passed 23 of 23.

Registry sizes: `retired-defs` 223 entries, `retired-keys` 268, `semantic` 466. The house sentence is in `packages/spec/src`, prescribing `os migrate meta --from 16` at 122 lines and `--from 17` at 114.

Refusal path, measured on a separate tree and not scored: the same `precision: 2` planted inside the stock `Field.currency({ … })` call on `semantic-zoo.object.ts` gave `Wrote 6 of 7`, listing it under `1 mechanical change(s) left for you to apply by hand:` with `not written [helper]: the value is built by Field.currency(…), not written as a literal`, and `Re-ran the chain over the written sources: only the 1 change(s) left above remain.` (exit 0). The item's third knownGap names this as the contract working, so the entry was re-planted as a plain literal for the scored leg above.
